name: Stream shorts — clip
description: A vertical short cut from a screen-share stream: the screen above, the camera below, the hook on screen from the first frame to the last. When the clip answers somebody, their message pops in over a blurred frame half a second in — with a bubble-burst — held while you read it out, and gone on the frame you finish; the captions never stop. Stalls and false starts come out; the voice stays.

selection.brief: One complete thing out of hours of a stream: a question from the chat read out with its whole answer, or one idea explained on its own. When it answers a chat message, start about half a second before you begin reading it out, so the clip opens on you and the hook before the message lands. End where the answer lands, and never cut the payoff. A clip has to make sense to somebody who has never seen the stream.
